description: Irregularities and unverified items for the Flagged for Review page. Blocking: none.

flags.kind: ONLY A LOCKED LINE; NO OPENING OR CLOSING
flags.detail: Each of the 39 originated markets now carries the single locked FanDuel line that nfl.com publishes in its weekly picks article (locked 2 p.m. ET Thursday). That corrects the ledger's earlier claim that no official source publishes a market line (finding F-01, request X3, suggestion SG-03). OPENING and CLOSING values are still not published by any official page, so all 78 opening/closing cells remain blank and are not inferred. The official game-centre page probed (NE at DET) does render no line, which is why the original probe missed the picks article; the picks article is the verified source.
flags.treatment: Locked line recorded verbatim with its source URL and lock statement; opening/closing left blank. Obtaining a true opening/closing series requires capturing the article repeatedly across a week (suggestion SG-L1 in ledger/index.html).

flags.detail: Two parallel sessions (fe499d4e, 08643438) both fixed the F-01 price claim from the same base on 2026-11-15. fe499d4e's merged version is kept as the store schema (official_locked_* + checker recompute guards); session 08643438's unique deltas were re-applied on top: snapshots[] now retains every dated locked-line reading on file - 87 rows (Weeks 9-10, 29 games x side/total/moneyline) with the picks-article verbatim text, lock statement and source URL. None of these are opening or closing numbers. The record of the collision lives in COORDINATION.md.
flags.treatment: Snapshots retained as dated history with source per row. Opening/closing stay blank (LF-01).

flags.kind: OFFICIAL PAGE PRINTS SCORES IN INCONSISTENT ORDER
flags.detail: On the nfl.com game-centre team strip for NE at DET, the New England results print the score in different orders. Compared with the scores pages: W6 prints 'Win 19-26' while the scores page gives NYJ 19, NE 26; W8 prints 'Win 24-19' with NE 24, MIA 19; W7 prints 'Loss 24-30' with NE 24, CHI 30; W9 prints 'Loss 45-27' with GB 45, NE 27. The strip sometimes lists the winner first and sometimes the loser first, so it cannot be read without checking the scores pages. The ledger does NOT take values from that strip; it uses the scores pages, which reconcile to the official standings 32/32 (origination/results/standings-reconciliation-2026-11-14.json).
flags.treatment: Not used as a value source. Recorded for review.

flags.detail: The official price probe read one Week 10 game-centre page (NE at DET, 2 chunks). It does not prove no official page anywhere carries a line. It is scoped accordingly. A broader search of nfl.com was not performed.
flags.treatment: Scope stated on the price store page. Absence of a line is recorded as blank, never as proof of non-existence.

flags.detail: The demotion thresholds (sample minimums, 14-day staleness, and the rules D1-D8) are proposals written by this session. The operator has not approved them. They are written down before any live window exists so they cannot be tuned to a result.
flags.treatment: Presented as a decision in ledger/index.html (SG-L2). Gate is inert until approved.

flags.detail: origination/scripts/model_w10.py evaluate() only computes G7 when a calibration table is passed. S9 (2-leg parlay) and S10 (same-game parlay) emit joint probabilities scored with Brier, yet G7 is recorded as null (not applicable) for both, and null is not counted as a failure by the verdict code (`v is False`). The fail-closed ledger counts null as FAIL for applicable gates. Verdicts are unchanged because S9 and S10 also fail G5/G6 and G4/G5.
flags.treatment: Recorded; origination history is not edited.

flags.detail: The Holm adjustment in origination runs across the 12 scored strategies only, while M1 and M2 (not scored) are excluded from the family. Holm across a family of 12 is the stated design; the family definition is a choice and is not reviewed here.
flags.treatment: Recorded for review. No change made.
